content.short: Mini Arena is a top-down shooter game with Pay-To-Spawn and Kill-To-Earn mechanics.
content.description: Mini Arena is a fast-paced top-down shooter that raises the stakes by letting players wager on themselves: you pay to enter and earn rewards for each kill, delivering an extra thrill in every duel. The game supports multiple blockchains—Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, and BNB Chain—and is accessible to anyone with a compatible wallet. By offering meaningful incentives to play, it addresses the aging gamer demographic's low engagement while delivering quick, intense battles for both veterans and newcomers.
